name: Treecko

atk.x: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

fl: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang from above.

name: Lotad
fl: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

name: Torchic

atk.x: Flip a coin. If tails, discard a Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon.

fl: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Staryu

atk.x: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

fl: It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.

name: Mudkip
fl: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

name: Pikachu

atk.x: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

fl: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

name: Electrike

atk.x: Search your deck for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

fl: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

name: Rhyhorn

atk.x: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

fl: It is inept at turning because of its four short legs. It can only charge and run in one direction.

name: Meditite
fl: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

name: Marill
fl: The tip of its tail is filled with oil that is lighter than water, so it acts as a float.

name: Zigzagoon

atk.x: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

fl: A Pokémon with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigzags.

name: Skitty

atk.x: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokémon is reduced by 20 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

fl: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.
